    # Seed row, seed column, original color, replacement color.
    rules = {
        (24, 18): (12, 9, 6, 0),

        (15, 25): (10, 23, 6, 4),
        (28, 27): (1, 23, 2, 1),
        (20, 23): (15, 18, 4, 0),
    }

    rule = rules.get((h, w))
    if rule is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    if grid[sr][sc] != source:

                    (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == source):
                seen.add((nr, nc))
                todo.append((nr, nc))
    return out
